aboutPage.title: La Nostra Storia
aboutPage.intro: Angelo Lens è una maison del colore — nata da una convinzione semplice: le lenti a contatto colorate meritano lo stesso rispetto dell'haute parfumerie.
aboutPage.p1: Angelo Lens nasce dallo spirito di un brand italiano. Proporzione, misura e cura del dettaglio stanno al centro del nostro linguaggio.
aboutPage.p2: Componiamo le collezioni come serie di colore — Vibe, Line, Leo ed Essence — curiamo packaging come un objet e parliamo un linguaggio più vicino alla moda che alla farmacia.
aboutPage.p3: Niente spettacolo. Nessun teatro clinico. Solo eleganza — misurata, intima e duratura. Trova Angelo Lens presso ottici selezionati.

instructionsPage.title: Istruzioni per l’uso
instructionsPage.intro: Questa pagina presenta le istruzioni della confezione Angelo Lens e una guida più completa alla cura delle lenti morbide.
instructionsPage.packagingAlt: Angelo Lens box panel with instructions and schematic drawings
instructionsPage.packagingCaption: Box panel: usage steps, warnings, and diagrams. See the detailed guide below for more.

insert.title: Inserting the Contact Lens
items: Wash your hands before handling contact lenses.
Place the lens on the tip of your index finger, pull your lower eyelid down, and place the lens on the cornea.
Then blink gently.

remove.title: Removing the Contact Lens
items: Wash your hands before removing contact lenses.
Looking up, slide the lens with your fingertip onto the white of the eye.
Gently pinch it with two fingers to remove it, then place it in a lens case filled with lens solution.

warnings.title: Important Warnings
items: Do not wear your lenses longer than the period recommended by the manufacturer.
Remove your lenses before sleeping.
Contact lenses are personal; do not share them with others.

contents.title: Box Contents
items: 2 soft contact lenses placed in saline solution inside 2 blisters.

disinfect.title: Disinfection
items: Always rinse the lens with lens solution before insertion and after wear.
After use, store lenses in a case filled with freshly changed solution.
If you do not wear your lenses often, renew the solution in the case after 7 days.

wash.title: Cleaning
items: Place the lens in your palm.
Apply a few drops of lens solution.
Rub both sides of the lens with your fingertip.
Rinse the lens.

diagrams.insert1: Hold the lens on your fingertip
diagrams.remove1: Slide the lens to the white of the eye

instructionsPage.detailIntro: The notes below are an Angelo Lens summary of widely accepted soft-lens safety practices. Your package insert and eye-care professional always come first.

hygiene.title: Hands and workspace
items: Wash your hands with soap and dry with a lint-free towel before touching lenses.
Work over a clean, flat surface; close the sink drain so a dropped lens is easier to find.
Keep fingernails from scratching the lens surface.

orientation.title: Orientation and inspection
items: Before insertion, check for tears, debris, or damage; do not wear a doubtful lens.
Correct orientation looks like a smooth bowl. Flared edges usually mean the lens is inside out.
Use the same order every time (for example right lens first) to avoid mixing pairs.

solutions.title: Solution use
items: Use only the care system recommended by your eye-care professional or product labeling.
Never use tap water, saliva, homemade saline, or refilled bottles of unknown origin.
Do not top off old solution; empty the case and refill with fresh solution each time.
Saline alone does not disinfect; use it for rinsing within a complete care regimen.
With hydrogen peroxide systems, wait until neutralization is complete before wearing.

case.title: Lens case hygiene
items: After inserting lenses, empty the case, rinse with solution, and air-dry open.
Clean lids and wells regularly; discard cracked or worn cases.
Replace the case about every 1–3 months.
If lenses sit unused, renew the solution; follow the 7-day reminder on the box and the solution label.

daily.title: Daily habits
items: Do not exceed the recommended wear schedule; remove lenses before sleep.
Avoid showering, swimming, or hot tubs while wearing lenses; water is not a lens disinfectant.
Insert lenses before makeup and remove them before makeup removal when possible.
Ask whether eye drops are lens-compatible; unsuitable drops can irritate.
Never share lenses; each pair belongs to one wearer only.

whenToStop.title: When to stop and seek help
items: Remove lenses immediately if you have severe redness, pain, burning, light sensitivity, sudden blur, or discharge.
If symptoms do not settle quickly, contact an eye-care professional; infections can become serious.
Do not force a lens that feels wrong; remove it, clean and rinse, or replace it.

disclaimer.title: Important note
disclaimer.body: This page is for general information and is not medical advice. Follow the product label, package insert, and guidance from a qualified optician or ophthalmologist. Obtain Angelo Lens products from authorized sellers.
